propositions: GitHub Actions run logs and metadata contain coverage % and CI-health data (status, duration, recovery intervals) but are subject to short retention windows, necessitating external harvesting.
The GHA adapter must parse coverage % from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health signals (red->green recovery, flake rate) from run metadata JSON.
Harvested metrics must be persisted as labeled snapshots to the tracked `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` store, not the gitignored `reports/` directory.
The harvest script runs locally/by maintainer via the GHA API, not via CI workflow, to avoid permission and commit constraints inherent to ephemeral CI checkouts.
The GHA adapter must remain isolated and optional; core metrics modules and future metrics commands must not import it, preserving portability to other CI systems.
